root_cause.text: In `f2fs_do_zero_range()`, when the zero-range operation yields no progress (i.e., `index == start`), the function unconditionally calls `f2fs_update_read_extent_cache_range()` and `f2fs_update_age_extent_cache_range()` with a zero length, which triggers a BUG_ON in `__update_extent_tree_range()` that validates non-zero extent length.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a conditional `if (index > start)` before invoking the extent cache update functions, directly preventing the zero-length extent insertion. The CVE description and commit message explicitly state: "In error path of f2fs_zero_range(), it may add a zero-sized extent into extent cache, it should be avoided." The kernel bug report shows a BUG at `fs/f2fs/extent_cache.c:678` with "extent len is zero".
